verses.text: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.

segments.text: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice;
Let the multitude of isles be glad.

verses.text: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

segments.text: Clouds and darkness are round about him:
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

verses.text: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.

segments.text: A fire goeth before him,
And burneth up his adversaries round about.

verses.text: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.

segments.text: His lightnings lightened the world:
The earth saw, and trembled.

verses.text: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

segments.text: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah,
At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.text: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.

segments.text: The heavens declare his righteousness,
And all the peoples have seen his glory.

verses.text: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.

segments.text: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images,

verses.text: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.

segments.text: Zion heard and was glad,

verses.text: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.

segments.text: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth:

verses.text: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

segments.text: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil:

verses.text: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.

segments.text: Light is sown for the righteous,

verses.text: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial name.
